statements.sql:
WITH target_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id
  FROM lix_file_history
  WHERE lixcol_start_commit_id = lix_active_branch_commit_id()
    AND path = '/notes/roadmap.md'
)
SELECT
  id,
  path,
  CAST(data AS TEXT) AS content,
  lixcol_depth,
  lixcol_observed_commit_id,
  lixcol_commit_created_at
FROM lix_file_history
WHERE lixcol_start_commit_id = lix_active_branch_commit_id()
  AND id IN (SELECT id FROM target_ids)
ORDER BY lixcol_commit_created_at DESC, lixcol_depth ASC
